definitions.explanation: An instrument for measuring air temperature. Literally 'cold-warm meter.' Used specifically for room or outdoor thermometers, not for medical thermometers.

examples.japanese: {寒暖計|かんだんけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧。
{寒暖計|かんだんけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{零下|れいか}→零下：17542_reika⟧5⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}している→示す：01948_shimesu⟧。
⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{掛|か}けた{寒暖計|かんだんけい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked the room temperature on the thermometer hanging on the wall.

notes:
USAGE:
{寒暖計|かんだんけい} refers to thermometers for measuring ambient air temperature. For medical thermometers used to measure body temperature, the word ⟦{体温計|たいおんけい}→体温計：05484_taionkei⟧ is used instead.

FORMS:
{寒|かん} (cold) + {暖|だん} (warm) + ⟦{計|けい}→計：02691_kei⟧ (meter/gauge).

RELATED WORDS:
⟦{温度計|おんどけい}→温度計：25699_ondokei⟧ is a more general term for any thermometer. ⟦{体温計|たいおんけい}→体温計：05484_taionkei⟧ is specifically for measuring body temperature.
